sourceScope.writer: Records complete introduction,22 main chapters and reading program, with selected notes only. Hash/interval integrity checked separately from root selected primary reading.
sourceScope.root: 34 actually read bounded primary intervals cover all21 proposed selections. Chapters20 and22 and the reading program read completely. No claim of root continuous whole-book reading.

findingsClosed.finding: Remove the closing clause about a new universal timetable invented on top of the book. Keep the actual statement that evening review tests the philosophy in everyday conduct. This clause addresses the production process rather than the book reader.

Delete the closing cannot honestly turn the section into a modern guide clause at sex-and-marriage and the retaining the thesis matters clause at political-extension. Keep the actual attributed ancient/author arguments, the polemic-versus-evidence distinction and discipline exception.

Replace the first sentence about a remark that cannot be removed without losing the argument with direct attribution and the concrete source/evidence limitation. Keep Irvine’s actual critique and his acknowledgment of professional help.

Make the final sentence directly state Irvine’s reconstruction argument; remove preserving its meaning means recognizing which speaks about retelling rather than the argument. Keep the logical analogy/effectiveness distinction.
Delete the sentence this is a paraphrase not an invented conversation. The actual colleague exchange, author attribution, response mechanism and limits already remain in the prose.

Core biographies are absent from Essential. Name Musonius Rufus and Marcus Aurelius in full at their first retained uses, so the short route does not require the omitted biography. Core also first names Musonius before its biography; use his full name there too.

RU title promises no counterhumiliation, while the actual source at022[8705,17493) explicitly says humor and nonresponse may wound/humiliate the insulter more than a direct counterinsult. Use a neutral humor/silence title in both languages and restore that short attributed consequence. Do not rewrite the book as an invariably gentle response.

meaningAssessment: Preserves the whole-life strategy, distinct ancient voices, virtue/tranquility disagreement, negative visualization and its grief limits, explicit Irvine reconstruction of control, past/present fatalism, voluntary discomfort, review and social duties, insults and discipline, grief/anger/wealth/exile/aging arguments, the author’s polemics and reconstruction, actual personal tests and final uncertainty. Concrete cases join the argument rather than generic moral lessons. The separate Russian editor objection remains separate. Author viewpoints have not been replaced by root preferences.
omissions: All22 main chapters, introduction and reading program represented. The map explicitly condenses biographies, subsidiary cases, lists, technical ancient-source detail and most notes. It does not reproduce every example or replace an unabridged edition. Historical clinical/political claims remain attributed arguments, not current therapeutic advice.

qa.postQaDifference: Only coverage acceptance/status metadata and documentation changed. Retelling, drafts, HTML, source ranges, chapter/unit maps and QA harness remain byte-identical to fresh QA. Original preacceptance flags in QA proofs are historical.
